title: LUNA HALONG CRUISE
summary: After check-in, guests are transferred to Luna Halong Cruise and welcomed on board.
exclusions: Round-trip transportation between Hanoi and Ha Long.
html:
08:30 – 09:00

Check-in and Transfer to Luna Halong Cruise

Guests check in at Halong International Cruise Port, Bai Chay Ward, Halong City.

After check-in, guests are transferred to Luna Halong Cruise and welcomed on board.

09:15 – 09:30

Cruise Departure

Luna Halong Cruise departs the port.

The journey to discover the breathtaking beauty of Ha Long Bay officially begins.

10:45 – 11:30

Surprising Cave Exploration

Visit Surprising Cave (Sung Sot Cave), a magnificent limestone cave filled with impressive stalactites and stalagmites.

This cave is ranked among the top ten most beautiful caves in the world by the Czech Association of Travel Agents and Brokers.

11:45 – 12:30

Titop Island Visit

Arrive at Titop Island.
Guests may swim in the crystal-clear turquoise water or climb to the top of the island to enjoy a panoramic view of Ha Long Bay.

12:30 – 13:30

International Buffet Lunch

Enjoy a premium buffet lunch at Luna Halong Cruise’s luxurious restaurant.
The menu features nearly one hundred Asian and European dishes prepared by professional chefs.

13:45 – 14:45

Luon Cave Discovery

Optional visit to Luon Cave, one of the most unique caves in Ha Long Bay.
Guests can choose to explore the cave by bamboo boat rowed by local people or by kayaking through the calm waters.

15:00 – 16:00

Teabreak Party and Live Music

Relax on the sundeck while enjoying a sunset teabreak party accompanied by live music on the fourth floor of the cruise.

16:30

Tour End

The cruise returns to the port.

Guests disembark and the tour officially ends.

INCLUSIONS

Welcome drink upon boarding.

Seven-hour Ha Long Bay day cruise itinerary.

English-speaking and Vietnamese-speaking tour guide.

Premium international buffet lunch with nearly one hundred Asian and European dishes.

Ha Long Bay entrance ticket.

Taxes, travel insurance, and service charge.

EXCLUSIONS

Round-trip transportation between Hanoi and Ha Long.

Cabin on board.

Kayaking or bamboo boat service at Luon Cave.

Spa and massage services, mineral bath.

Beverages.

Tips, personal expenses, and all other services not clearly mentioned above.
